title: Budget vs actual for 10 jobs: how the job-cost pilot works
description:
What you send and what you get back: the job costing exception report pilot for contractors and small construction firms.

Job-Cost Exception Report: a pilot offer from Amber One. The sample uses an invented business and invented data. A person reviews every report before it goes to you. Narrated with a synthetic voice.

#jobcosting #contractors

See the sample report and the pilot terms: https://hq.amberoneai.com/offers/job-cost-exceptions?src=youtube&utm_campaign=job-cost-how-it-works
narration: How the job-cost exception pilot works, for builders with a handful of active jobs.
You send job budgets by cost code, the month's cost transactions, and percent complete from your project manager.
You get budget against actual for each job and cost code, and a short list of exceptions, each with the transactions behind it.
No login to your accounting software, and nothing is posted or changed.
Up to 10 active jobs, one month of costs, then one refresh. The price and terms are on the page.
